Technical Notes

          
Entropy (bits) = Length × log2(Character Pool Size). A 24-character mixed-charset password yields >142 bits of entropy.

          
Frequently Asked Questions

          
Does this use Math.random() or Web Crypto?
It uses the browser's cryptographically secure `window.crypto.getRandomValues()` CSPRNG.
